root_cause.text: The TCP MD5 signature handling in `net/ipv4/tcp.c`, `net/ipv4/tcp_ipv4.c`, and `net/ipv6/tcp_ipv6.c` used `memcmp()` to verify 16-byte MD5 MACs, which can short-circuit on the first differing byte and thus leaks timing information instead of performing a constant-time comparison.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `memcmp(hash_location, newhash, 16)` / `memcmp(md5_hash_location, newhash, 16)` with `crypto_memneq(..., 16)` in the TCP MD5 inbound and RST paths, and adds `select CRYPTO_LIB_UTILS` plus `#include <crypto/utils.h>`, confirming the bug was insecure non-constant-time MAC comparison in the TCP-MD5 subsystem.
